forms={
 'A': lambda p: -p[0]*t**p[1]*A**p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*A) + p[4]*A**p[5]*t**p[6]*np.exp(-p[7]*t),
 'B': lambda p: -p[0]*t**p[1]*A**p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*A*t) + p[4]*A**p[5]*t**p[6]*np.exp(-p[7]*t),
 'C': lambda p: -p[0]*t**p[1]*A**p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*A) + p[4]*A**p[5]*t**p[6],
 'D': lambda p: -p[0]*t**p[1]*A**p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*A) + p[4]*A**p[5]*np.exp(-p[6]*t)+p[7]*A*t**p[8],
}
rng=np.random.default_rng(2)
for name,f in forms.items():
    n=len(__import__('inspect').signature(f) and [0]*0) 
    best=(9,None)
    for k in range(40):
        p0=rng.uniform(-1.5,2,9)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-dA_dt, p0, max_nfev=2000)
            v=np.mean(r.fun**2)/V
            if np.isfinite(v) and v<best[0]: best=(v,r.x)
        except Exception: pass
    print(name, best[0], np.round(best[1],3))
